Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Is watching a bright screen (computer/TV) in the dark damaging to your eyes?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Sure! Here’s how I would explain it to a 5-year-old:

When it’s dark and you look at a bright screen, like a TV or computer, your eyes have to work extra hard because the light is much brighter than the room around you. This can make your eyes tired and a little sore, kind of like how it feels when you play outside a lot and your legs get tired. But, it won’t make your eyes broken or really hurt them forever. Still, it’s better to have some soft light in the room when you look at a bright screen, so your eyes don’t get as tired.
